title: Mistral’s Large 4 open weights arrive with a 1-point coding lead over GLM-5.3: "There’s nothing you can’t do with this model that you can do with competitors."
author: Meredith Shubel
zh_title: Mistral开源大模型Large 4发布：编程能力领先GLM-5.3一个百分点
zh_summary: Mistral AI正式发布开源大模型Mistral Large 4 (ML4)，在编程和网络安全基准测试中以极低成本微超GLM-5.3。高管强调开源权重对企业的重要性，并透露未来将推出适合笔记本运行的轻量化版本。
